data.one_liner: A type‑safe wrapper around SharedPreferences with observers and DAO support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a typed API for reading and writing SharedPreferences values, automatically prefixes keys, and caches entries. Adds observer hooks to react to preference changes and lets you define DAOs for schema‑like access.
use_when: You want compile‑time type safety for preference keys
You need to react to preference changes via observers
You prefer a DAO‑style, declarative definition of stored values
avoid_when: You only need a few simple key‑value pairs and want minimal overhead
You require encrypted or secure storage out of the box
weaknesses: Adds an extra abstraction layer over SharedPreferences
Breaking API change in 0.2.0 (generics must extend Object)
Limited to SharedPreferences; no built‑in encryption

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Direct access with no extra abstraction if you only need basic key‑value storage
